prompt: The first three images are the locked rendering style for this game (stylized painterly high-fantasy sky islands). The other five are approved Galeborne architecture concept sheets (dwelling, civic shipyard, landmark beacon spire, outpost pavilion, props). Galeborne are wind-riders who build to leave: narrow tall stacked nest-houses on rock needles, cantilevered decks, sails and rigging. I now need MODULAR 3D KIT reference sheets so a 3D artist can build every one of those concept buildings from snapping pieces. Galeborne grid: 2 m horizontal module, 3 m storey, thin 0.3 m timber or stone skin, narrow tall stacks of 3 to 5 storeys, cantilevered decks. Kit-sheet rules (different from the concept sheets): landscape sheet; orthographic FRONT ELEVATION of every piece plus a small three-quarter view beside it; every piece ISOLATED (no scenery, no floating rock, no sky); light neutral grey background with faint module grid lines (2 m horizontal, 3 m storey) and a small dimension label under each piece; one human-height figure (about 1.9 m, tall and slender) for scale; consistent flat even light, softer and less sepia than the concept sheets; painterly hand-painted surfaces, chunky readable game-asset forms, detail painted not modelled. Galeborne materials (NOT the Accord look, no whitewash, NO terracotta): pale silvered weathered timber, grey-blue slate or wooden shingle roofs, cream sailcloth with teal and gold trim, rope lashings, brass fittings; more sail and rigging, less house. Generate sheet 1 of 5, KIT-STRUCTURE, titled 'Galeborne kit: structure', pieces in tidy rows: rock-needle foundation collar, cliff-edge cantilever deck bracket, deck tiles (2x2 m), timber-frame walls (plain, window, door, half-height, end cap, sailcloth panel wall), outer corner, inner corner, mast column, straight stair, spiral stair, rope-railed balcony, ladders.
